steps.caption: Open More → Automation, then the Background jobs tab.
Every background job, with its state: Waiting, Running, Completed, Failed — will retry, or Failed.
'Delayed' means it is past its due time — usually the scheduler is busy or not running.
Module: which part of CRE OS the job belongs to — Scoring, Research, Daily brief, Deal Toolkit…
When it was due, when it finished (and how long it took), and retries used out of the attempts allowed.
Failed jobs show the reason in red.
Filters: All, Waiting, Delayed, Failed, Completed. Choose Completed.
Completed jobs with their finish time.
Choose Failed to see what needs a look.
Failed jobs: the module and the error. Jobs that can retry say 'will retry'.
Work handed to specialist modules: events passed on (a signal, a meeting outcome, an employer change) and whether that module finished.
Only admins see job details; other users see a short note instead.
